text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One holiday. Jungle Pocket was competing in a street race with her crew.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I win!
Running wild hasn't made me rusty, has it?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
That was insane, that run just now.
I felt way more "pressure" from it than before...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right?
I've finally figured out what my true weapon is.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait, that's not it.
It's what they—what my Trainer taught me."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: When I was running alongside someone strong at the academy—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...!
Damn it!! I couldn't reach them...!
choice_data_list: Looks like your pace falling apart midway is what did it.
Looks like your pace falling apart midway is what did it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I get it, but still.
Seeing running like that makes you wanna sink your teeth into 'em, right?
choice_data_list: Then let's bottle up that fighting spirit until the very last second.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: He told me: "That fighting spirit is your weapon."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hold back the urge to blow right past your prey,
and unleash it all at the very end—that's how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Sounds like that guy
really gets you, Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haha, well of course! You're the Trainer I acknowledged as my partner, after all!
